## Retrieving uniform references

This code retrieves the relevant references in APA style from Crossref, so that they can be merged into the dataset during cleaning.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
fred_validated_raw <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv", skip = 1)

source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrtproject/FReD-data/refs/heads/main/clean_cos_fred.R")

# No filter for validated so that we get as many refs as possible

clean_res <- clean_fred_data(fred_validated_raw)$cleaned_data

dois_o <- clean_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(doi_o)) %>%
  distinct(doi_o) %>%
  pull(doi_o)


dois_r <- clean_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(doi_r)) %>%
  distinct(doi_r) %>%
  pull(doi_r)

doi_attempt <- c(dois_o, dois_r) %>% str_subset("^10\\.")

```


```{r}

refs_df <- 
  readxl::read_excel("crossref_retrieved_references.xlsx")  

missing_dois <- setdiff(tolower(doi_attempt), tolower(refs_df$doi))

refs <- rcrossref::cr_cn(missing_dois, 
                         format = "text", style = "apa", .progress = "text")

refs_df_new <- tibble(doi = str_extract(unlist(refs), "https://doi\\.org/.*") %>% 
                    str_remove("https://doi\\.org/"), reference = unlist(refs))

# Clean up references
refs_df_new <- refs_df_new %>%
    # Convert to title case when more than 50% CAPS
    mutate(reference = ifelse(str_count(reference, "[A-Z]") / str_count(reference, "[A-Za-z]") > 0.5,
                            stringr::str_to_title(reference),
                            reference)) %>% 
  # upated preprints in PsyArxiv are references only as WITHDRAWN in crossref
  filter(!str_detect(reference, "WITHDRAWN") & !str_detect(doi, "osf\\.io")) %>% 
  distinct()

refs_df_new <- refs_df_new %>%
  filter(!doi %in% refs_df$doi)


```

# Check for mismatches

Check whether any dois returned references unrelated to the earlier ones

```{r}
library(stringdist)

# simple cleaner for text chunks
clean_ref <- function(x) {
  x |>
    tolower() |>
    str_replace_all("https?://\\S+", " ") |>   # remove URLs
    str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") |>     # remove punctuation
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") |>            # collapse spaces
    str_trim()
}


# compare two refs focusing on post-year chunk
# word containment similarity
containment_sim <- function(a, b) {
  a_words <- str_split(clean_ref(a), "\\s+")[[1]] |> unique()
  b_words <- str_split(clean_ref(b), "\\s+")[[1]] |> unique()
  short <- if (length(a_words) <= length(b_words)) a_words else b_words
  long  <- if (length(a_words) >  length(b_words)) a_words else b_words
  mean(short %in% long)  # fraction of shorter string's words in the longer
}

clean_res %>% 
  filter(status != "validated - discarded") %>% 
  transmute(doi_o = tolower(doi_o), ref_o) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(doi = doi_o, reference = ref_o) %>%
  bind_rows(
    clean_res %>% 
        filter(status != "validated - discarded") %>% 
      transmute(doi_r = coalesce(url_r, tolower(doi_r)), ref_r) %>%
        distinct() %>% 
      filter(!is.na(doi_r)) %>%
      rename(doi = doi_r, reference = ref_r)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(doi)) %>%
  rename(ref_old = reference) %>%
  left_join(refs_df_new) %>%
  filter(!is.na(reference)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(contained_share = containment_sim(ref_old, reference)) %>%
  arrange(contained_share)  %>% 
  writexl::write_xlsx("doi_reference_alignment_check.xlsx")


refs_df %>% 
  bind_rows(refs_df_new) %>%
  writexl::write_xlsx("crossref_retrieved_references.xlsx")  

unresolved_doi <- setdiff(tolower(doi_attempt), c(tolower(refs_df$doi), tolower(refs_df_new$doi)))

library(httr)

check_doi <- function(doi) {
  url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
  res <- httr::HEAD(url)
  status <- status_code(res)
  if (status == 200) {
    return(TRUE)   # DOI resolves
  } else {
    return(FALSE)  # Not resolvable
  }
}


doi_check <- map_lgl(unresolved_doi, ~ check_doi(.x), .progress = TRUE)

problematic_dois <- unresolved_doi[!doi_check]

# Sometimes Google Sheets incremented DOIs when pulling down
# - to identify these cases, we can try decrementing the final number and see if that resolves

check_previous_doi <- function(doi) {
  base_url <- "https://doi.org/"
  
  # internal helper
  resolves <- function(d) {
    res <- try(httr::HEAD(paste0(base_url, d)), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(res, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
    status_code(res) == 200
  }
  
  # main logic
  if (resolves(doi)) {
    return(doi)
  } else if (str_detect(doi, "\\d$")) {
    # if ends with digit, try decremented version
    num <- as.integer(str_extract(doi, "\\d+$"))
    doi_prev <- str_replace(doi, "\\d+$", as.character(num - 1))
    if (resolves(doi_prev)) {
      return(doi_prev)
    } else {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
  } else {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}

doi_check2 <- map_chr(unresolved_doi, ~ check_previous_doi(.x), .progress = TRUE)

increments <- tibble(original_doi = unresolved_doi, checked_doi = doi_check2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(checked_doi), !(original_doi == checked_doi))

library(rcrossref)
inc_check <- increments %>% mutate(
  new_ref = cr_cn(checked_doi, format = "text", style = "apa")
) %>% left_join(clean_res %>% select(ref_o, doi_o), by = c("checked_doi" = "doi_o")) %>%
  left_join(clean_res %>% select(ref_r, doi_r), by = c("checked_doi" = "doi_r"))


issues <- unresolved_doi[is.na(doi_check2)] %>% unique()

augm_refs <- clean_res %>% filter(doi_r %in% issues) %>% 
  select(doi_r, ref_r) %>% 
  distinct(ref_r, .keep_all = TRUE) 

augm_refs <- map_dfr(augm_refs$ref_r, function(q) {
  tryCatch(
    cr_works(q = q, limit = 1)$data %>% 
      select(any_of(c("doi", "source", "title", "container.title"))),
    error = function(e) tibble(doi = NA, source = NA, title = NA)
  )
} ) %>% bind_cols(augm_refs)

augm_refs %>% clipr::write_clip()

```
